name: Board API on Vercel
notes: One function. openBoardApi requires LLDAP Redis and NEXTAUTH_SECRET. Loads and saves Atlas when MONGODB_URI is set.

name: Fargate board task
notes: Task env sets PORT only. Without MONGODB_URI the store is the in-memory demo board. Do not send Vercel tokens here.

name: Nutshell auth proxy
notes: Forwards the body and the first X-Forwarded-For value. Does not store the password. On 200 upserts the user into Atlas.

name: Nutshell MCP proxy
notes: Install URL is https://hackohio-2026.vercel.app/mcp. This is not the Python MCP process.

name: Python MCP
notes: FastMCP on task port 8080 path /mcp. Empty BOARD_API_URL leaves the process up and fails the tool call.

name: In-process MCP
notes: Server name nutshell. Protocol 2025-03-26. Same policy as the HTTP routes.

name: LLDAP
notes: Login binds as uid=user ou=people dc=hackohio dc=local. Signup uses the password-modify operation. Admin UI is TCP 17170.

name: Redis
notes: Rate counters buc2:rl:* and channels buc2:events buc2:user:<id> buc2:agent:<id>. No disk and no TLS.

name: Atlas
notes: Database hackathon. The ticket API and the Nutshell board route both write it.

name: POST /auth/signup
notes: Creates the directory user and a usr_ token. 5 attempts per hour per address and per username.

name: POST /auth/login
notes: LDAP bind then a usr_ token with all four scopes. 8 attempts per 15 minutes per address and per username.

name: GET /health
notes: Returns status ok.

name: GET or POST /mcp
notes: initialize tools/list and tools/call.

name: GET /project-templates
notes: Each template is a board a table or a roadmap.

name: GET /project-templates/:id
notes: Layout columns fields and starter tags.

name: GET /projects
notes: Projects kept on the board.

name: POST /projects
notes: Creates a project from a template. The key is the ticket prefix.

name: GET /projects/:key/table
notes: One project as groups and rows.

name: PATCH /projects/:key
notes: Updates that project. The store checks the actor.

name: DELETE /projects/:key
notes: Deletes the project and notes it so persistBoard removes the mirrored documents.

name: GET /tickets
notes: Optional status query.

name: POST /tickets
notes: Starts in backlog. Key comes from the project prefix.

name: GET /tickets/:key
notes: One ticket.

name: PATCH /tickets/:key
auth: tickets:write and tickets:close to reach done
notes: Edit move approve or link a commit. An agent move includes sha message added and removed.

name: DELETE /tickets/:key
notes: Deletes that ticket. The store checks the actor.

name: GET /tickets/:key/comments
notes: Optional since timestamp.

name: POST /tickets/:key/comments
notes: Adds a comment.

name: GET /events
notes: Newest first. The stream sends stream_open then stored events then live Redis messages.

name: GET /agents
notes: Agents and owners. No secrets.

name: POST /agents
notes: Connects an agent for the signed-in person. Returns the one-time secret and mcp install object.

name: POST /agents/:id/tokens
notes: Issues a clw_ token. The secret is returned once.

name: POST /agents/:id/revoke
notes: Revokes the agent and its tokens.

name: GET /users
notes: People on the board.

name: GET /teams
notes: Teams and members.

name: GET /organization
notes: Name token lifetime and rules.

name: PATCH /organization
notes: Updates name expiry or the three rules. Expiry may be 1 8 24 72 or 168 hours.

name: get_board
notes: Optional status.

name: create_ticket
notes: Title and optional label and reviewer.

name: move_ticket
notes: Status plus an optional commit.

name: add_comment
notes: Comment body.

name: read_comments
notes: Present on the in-process server. The Python server does not expose this tool.

name: link_commit
notes: Commit only. No status change.

name: watch_changes
notes: Newest events. Optional since.

name: list_project_templates
notes: Template catalog.

name: get_project_template
notes: One template.

name: get_project_table
notes: Groups and rows.

name: create_project
notes: Name key and template id.

name: rest_state
notes: Whole board snapshot written by persistBoard.

name: users
notes: Human profile. No password field.

name: projects
notes: Layout columns fields and starter tags.

name: tickets
notes: Status reviewer needs_approval and linked commits.

name: comments
notes: Author body and time.

name: events
notes: Append-only activity.

name: agents
notes: Owner connection scopes and revoked.

name: organization
notes: Name expiry and rules.

name: agent_tokens
notes: SHA-256 token_hash for clw_ tokens. The raw secret is not this field.

name: auth_tokens
notes: Keeps the bearer secret so a later request can match it. The document id is the SHA-256 of the secret.

name: approve_before_close
notes: Starts on. An agent cannot approve or close. A human cannot approve their own ticket.

name: commit_on_move
notes: Starts on. The commit is sha message added and removed and is stored before the status change.

name: log_agent_actions
notes: Starts on. Agent mutations are appended to the event log.

name: token lifetime
notes: Default 24 hours. A clw_ token cannot be wider than its agent.
